page_title: POETIC MIND SCENTED WARDROBE BAR PACK (PACK OF 4) - Dusty pink | ZARA United States
headings: POETIC MIND SCENTED WARDROBE BAR PACK (PACK OF 4)

jsonld_raw.name: POETIC MIND SCENTED WARDROBE BAR PACK (PACK OF 4)
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented ceramic wardrobe bars. They can be hung on the wardrobe rail, from hangers, or between clothes, even inside drawers.

Set of 4.

Poetic Mind | From the sparkling explosion of bergamot zest, Poetic Mind expresses its soft and delicate signature. The majestic floral heart conveys a sense of depth and seduction thanks to an authentic bouquet of roses intoxicated by the timeless beauty of jasmine. The cozy base notes combine the warmth of soft woods and the voluptuousness of vanilla.

Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, aldehydic notes, elemi, almond flower.
Heart notes: heliotrope, rose, jasmine, incense.
Base notes: woody, sandalwood, vanilla, musk.
